title: Proportion of Social Service Agencies Paying Employees According to Social Service Sector Salary Guidelines
what_it_is: Proportion of Social Service Agencies Paying Employees According to Social Service Sector Salary Guidelines

sections.label: Social service salary guidelines review
sections.summary: MSF reviews and raises social service salary guidelines, adjusts programme funding, and works with SSAs on salary adherence.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Over the years, the Ministry for Social and Family Development (MSF) has reviewed and raised the salary guidelines so that wages in the social service sector remain competitive against comparable roles in competing markets.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Correspondingly, MSF adjusts programme funding to enable funded SSAs to pay employees according to the latest guidelines.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Our data suggests that SSAs have generally been keeping pace with these updates to the salary guidelines.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Over the past three years, MSF and NCSS have worked with SSAs to progressively improve adherence to the salary guidelines.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Beyond current efforts, such as supporting SSAs in enhancing their human resources (HR) practices, we engage SSA leaders on their organisations' salary adherence and benchmark them to their peers.

sections.label: Wage adherence and turnover study
sections.summary: No correlation or impact study on wage adherence and turnover has been done, but case load strongly affects possible turnover.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We thank the Member for the supplementary questions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We have not done any correlation or impact study on wage adherence with turnover.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: But certainly, case load has a strong impact on possible turnover; and it is something that we always are mindful of, and we make sure that the case load and the funding and the number of social workers that each programme needs would be commensurate.

sections.label: Smaller communities overheads and resources
sections.summary: Smaller communities have overheads and smaller programme funding, so MSF engages them on resources and HR practices.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: For smaller communities, certainly, they have overheads, like every other SSAs, but they may have a smaller programme funding possibility.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: And therefore we are engaging them regularly to make sure that they are keeping up and also can tap on a number of resources that are available to upgrade, improve HR practices, for example, and even tap on expertise, which may be available for free from corporates who provide them as part of their pro bono services, or part of their corporate social responsibility services.
